<p class="eyebrow">Monthly Regime History</p>
<h2 class="dashboard-title">Economic regime path, 2007-01 to 2026-04</h2>
<p class="dashboard-intro">
Month-by-month regime map built from the public Treasury curve, macro-market signals, and the project’s scenario engine.
Each month encodes the dominant regime, whether the month looked macro-confirmed or flow-amplified, and the strongest
driver family. The underlying SVG includes month-level tooltips with curve, market, and path evidence.
</p>
:::

:::

::: {.dashboard-card}
<p class="dashboard-card-label">Fill</p>
<h3>Monthly regime</h3>
<p><code>inflation shock</code>, <code>growth scare</code>, <code>policy constraint</code>, or <code>mixed transition</code>.</p>
:::

::: {.dashboard-card}
<p class="dashboard-card-label">Top stripe</p>
<h3>Expected vs unexpected</h3>
<p><code>macro-confirmed</code>, <code>contested</code>, or <code>flow-amplified</code> based on the month’s justification mix.</p>
:::

::: {.dashboard-card}
<p class="dashboard-card-label">Dot</p>
<h3>Strongest driver</h3>
<p>Monthly dominant driver family from the signal pack: inflation, risk, policy, surprise, or transition.</p>
:::
